name: Colorado Trail Day 20: Silverton to Blackhawk Pass
gear: New Balance Hierro v8  Shadow Grey
description:
Ended up taking a zero in Silverton to avoid another storm because I've been having a hard time feeling present on the trail and I think weather anxiety has been a part of that. Will cost me finishing the trail in under 3 weeks but I would have just had to spend an extra day in Durango anyways. Was nice to be cozy in an Avon hostel bed while the rain came down. Visited the surprisingly good museum and the Hardrock rock. Walked up to the Jesus statue. Ate a lot of food. Feel like I really seen everything in Silverton now. For a hitch from Nate who works in mining and his giant bear dog who barked aggressively but then smothered me laying in my lap

The trail was icy and muddy but it was a nice day with the lightest sunny snowfall which was pleasant. Views continue to be great. Last leg!
